issues: sub-03 inherited contamination from sub-02 (4 stale fetched-branch merge commits); resolved by cherry-picking only report 04 onto feature branch

lessons_learned: Concurrent subagents in a shared sandbox workdir stomp on each other's branches. Future fanout dispatch should use isolation: "worktree" in the Agent calls so each subagent has its own workdir.

Cherry-picking the deliverable files directly from each sub-branch — instead of doing 3-way merges — is a clean fallback when sub-branches got cross-contaminated. Each subagent's deliverables were file-bounded (one report per branch) which made this trivial.

Fetch workflow body extraction: issue #12 failed because its body format wasn't recognized by extract_urls.py. Subagent retried with the JSON-in-code-block format from prior issues #5/#6 as #13, which succeeded. The pattern is: copy the format from the previous successful fetch issue.

MCP github tools' repository-scope restriction (lago-morph/agent-runner only) means subagents can't use mcp__github__get_file_contents for external repos like grll/* or OpenHands/* — must use raw.githubusercontent.com + WebFetch.
